verdict.comment: Several with claims but HAVE SECRET gets the nod after following his ready C&D win in April with a third at the York Dante meeting.

comments.arthursrealm: Fair fifth in Spring Mile latest and won Zetland Gold Cup off 1lb higher last May; player
comments.bigmeeting: Useful in 2022 but not seen again until well held in early 2024 and off again   since
comments.eyupitstheboss: Good Ripon record and 1m4f likely stretched him at York latest; has to enter calculations
comments.financer: Chased home Have Secret on C&D reappearance and excuse at York since
comments.firstview: Held by the reopposing Padishakh on his recent return to Britain at Nottingham
comments.havesecret: Right back in form this spring, winning over C&D before third at York; should figure again
comments.highpoint: Seventh on AW both starts this year but a 3-6 turf record affords him respect; rain a help
comments.letsdream: Lwo-mileage 4yo who arrives on the back of a win at Chester May meeting; respected
comments.padishakh: Winning start for Ed Bethell over 1m at Nottingham and remains well treated on old form
comments.titian: Off for 160 days but can't be discounted having won this off 2lb higher last year
comments.touchthemoon: Solid return to Britain when third over 1m4f here last month; respected in new cheekpieces
comments.yorkshirelady: No impact over hurdles this winter and well held back on Flat here last month

races.raceComment: eyupitstheboss is marginally preferred with a score of 58.5%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over havesecret. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Plenty of possibles but 2023 winner HURSTWOOD (nap) ran well at Thirsk on his return to turf and can prove too strong for Juryman.

comments.bellagioman: 2023 turf form gives him a squeak off his lowly mark; risky but could go well
comments.better: Lower rating on turf but with some justification; laboured sixth at Thirsk 12 days ago
comments.canariaqueen: Not at best here 11 days ago but rain won't hurt and she's fully effective at 6f
comments.eldeyaar: Two C&D wins to his name and 5lb lower than for the latest; not at best so far this year
comments.elliott: Disappointing favourite on his return to Britain; change of headgear today; risky
comments.enderman: Third in this race in 2022 on his only other Ripon run; dangerous mark and rain no problem
comments.fumbleinthejungle: Finished last in both runs back from mammoth absence; new cheekpieces not enough to tempt
comments.goldenprosperity: Yet to win at 6f and not hit top form so far this year; others appeal more
comments.hurstwood: 1st and 2nd in the last two runnings; good second at Thirsk 12 days ago; solid candidate
comments.isheworthagamble: 6f win at Leicester on return; similar form under penalty latest; rain perhaps not ideal
comments.juryman: Not beaten far at Thirsk (behind Hurstwood) 12 days ago; rain would aid his cause
comments.missrainbow: Exposed maiden but her reappearance wasn't without hope; each-way claims
comments.missmimi: AW win last September (6f); has run well over C&D; yard in fine form; considered
comments.tickets: Better on AW but handicapped accordingly and won well at Redcar last month
comments.varietyisland: Two good runs this year and rain won't bother him; yet to shine at Ripon though

races.raceComment: hurstwood is marginally preferred with a score of 52.7%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and more progressive over varietyisland. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Having gone close at Hamilton early this month, MASEKELA was denied a clear run at York's Dante meeting and gets the nod.

comments.ancientmyth: Remains lightly raced but has been unable to recapture the promise of his debut second
comments.clansman: His form has been mixed across his six runs since last September but rain would be a plus
comments.curran: Took step back in the right direction last month and this longer trip is worth another go
comments.freespeech: Below best on AW this year but could bounce back with a bold show if slow ground prevails
comments.freedomday: Something to prove regarding current form but well treated and is back up in trip today
comments.masekela: Ages since he won but promising signs of late and he's one to consider
comments.something: On a handy mark on his AW form from the end of last year and could have a part to play
comments.tokyobay: Won heavy-ground C&D maiden last April but unable to kick on since
comments.valleyofflowers: Further is preferable and she lacks a recent run, but she ran well first time up last year
comments.warriorlion: 0-21 but one to keep a close eye on in the betting on stable debut

races.raceComment: valleyofflowers is marginally preferred with a score of 56.5%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more progressive over freespeech. Placed in 4 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 3 wins from 16 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.cosmosraj: Clear of rest when second over 1m2f here recently and the one to beat off same mark

comments.havanaprince: Redcar winner last month; also a dual C&D scorer and should remain competitive up 4lb
comments.mariner: 1mf course win this month; failed to stay 1m4f latest and likely still in form
comments.volenti: Four AW wins since last autumn but well held back on turf here latest

comments.alshabab: 19-race maiden who's been expensive to follow on AW; not the percentage call back up to 1m
comments.almizan: Unexposed and her last run was her best one; turf should be fine; interesting
comments.create: Has run well the last twice and should do so again but needs to confirm a mile still suits
comments.crowdquake: Won two of his last three; sharp drop in trip not ideal but at least he's in form; player
comments.edvardgrieg: Sprinting backfired latest; respectable efforts around this trip previously; thereabouts
comments.fastflo: 38-race maiden who has finished down the field the last twice; passed over
comments.heerssadie: Backward step last time at a track she generally goes well at; that raises a question
comments.kessaarpower: Not beaten far last time (7f, AW) and he goes off the same mark; turf and trip fine
comments.pendingappeal: Latest second in a classified (AW) was better; needs to build on that now back on turf
comments.primrosemaid: Tailed off last time and can only be watched
comments.specialistview: Sole win came on AW; might have needed latest run and she's not totally ruled out
comments.unitedforce: 1lb lower than when winning over C&D last July; solid latest; might be the answer

races.raceComment: unitedforce is marginally preferred with a score of 48.5%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over fastflo. verdict.comment: Easing ground would be to the advantage of BAY BREEZE who has dropped 1lb lower than when winning at Nottingham last October.

comments.baybreeze: Has dropped 1lb below his last winning mark; major player with the ground easing
comments.biplane: Remains 5lb above her highest winning mark and wouldn't want too much rain ideally
comments.gisellesizzy: Patchy form since latest win off 12lb higher; not quite sure what to expect
comments.princeofbellir: Quiet in his last four starts and needs to be reinvigorated by the change of yards
comments.silentflame: Acts on any ground but she has a modest record fresh so the 233-day absence is a concern
comments.sirgarfield: Most starts over 7f, but this could become a stiffer test if the rain arrives
comments.sirmaxi: Four-time winner on turf and should be suited by this stiff 6f; visor on; shortlisted
comments.thornabypearl: Has become well treated; return to this trip should suit and rain will aid his cause
comments.yazaman: Completed a four-timer in the middle of last year, but is 0-32 over 6f and beyond

races.raceComment: sirmaxi is marginally preferred with a score of 50.4%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over sirgarfield. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Soft ground from 28 attempts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The vote goes to BRUMMELL whose successful Beverley reappearance suggests he is still improving.

comments.blindbeggar: Back off last winning mark; interesting, especially if they elect to come stands' side
comments.brummell: Suited by a stiff finish; 4lb higher than for winning Beverley return but still improving
comments.emeraldspride: Still 5lb above her last winning mark and significant rain may pose a problem
comments.gloriousangel: One win in last 33 starts and may need this after three months off as well
comments.hyperfocus: Nine wins on good to soft or slower, but off seven months and has no great record fresh
comments.impressor: Rain would be very much in his favour, but record suggests this run may be needed
comments.invincibleannice: Failed to beat a rival on last month's stable debut/reappearance; enough to prove
comments.irishnectar: Rain would be welcome, but he needed his reappearance last year; may be best watched
comments.minniewildes: Twice held in AW handicaps after winning first two starts; may be interesting back on turf
comments.moonstoneboy: Just beaten on last month's Musselburgh return; rain and return to a stiff track helpful
comments.neverdark: Has gone well fresh before and rain wouldn't be an issue; each-way claims
comments.waterofleith: 1lb well in, but all turf wins have come on good or faster ground; rain could be a problem

races.raceComment: waterofleith is marginally preferred with a score of 51.9%, holding clear edges in more progressive over moonstoneboy. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include positive comments, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
